text: [Figure 2-1] Ship symbol at the bottom of the drawing with a black arrow labeled "BRC" pointing straight ahead (up the page).
[Figure 2-1] The departure track (orange line) runs straight ahead from the ship, parallel to the BRC arrow; this segment is labeled "500' / 300 KIAS".
[Figure 2-1] A cross-mark on the track at the end of the straight segment is labeled "7 DME"; at this point the track turns (drawn toward the upper right).
[Figure 2-1] The segment after the turn at 7 DME is labeled "Climb on course, VMC".

[Figure 2-2] Ship symbol at the bottom of the drawing with a black arrow labeled "BRC" pointing straight ahead; the departure track (orange line) runs straight ahead from the ship parallel to BRC. No altitude, airspeed or distance label is printed on this straight segment.
[Figure 2-2] Two short horizontal orange lines are drawn beside (to the right of) the straight segment; they carry no label.
[Figure 2-2] At the end of the straight segment there is an unlabeled cross-mark; from it the track splits and curves both left and right to join a large arc labeled "10 DME Arc".
[Figure 2-2] At the upper left, a line labeled "Departure Radial" leaves the 10 DME arc outbound.
